title: 職場の本音・応用編（長い掛け合い）

items.en: Hey, Jordan, you got a minute? I wanna talk about yesterday.
items.jp: ねえジョーダン、ちょっといい？昨日のことで話したいんだ。
items.speak: Hey, Jordan, you got a minute? I wanna talk about yesterday.
items.note: 元の形: have you got／want to／聞こえ方: ガタ／ワナ／使う場面:話を切り出す時

items.en: It's kinda the thing. You said 'we' built it, but I built it.
items.jp: そこなんだ。君は『一緒に』作ったと言ったけど、作ったのは私だよ。
items.speak: It's kinda the thing. You said 'we' built it, but I built it.
items.note: 元の形: kind of／聞こえ方: カインダ／使う場面:やんわり切り出す時

items.en: I was put on the spot. I panicked, and 'we' just came out.
items.jp: 急に振られて、焦って、つい『一緒に』と出てしまった。
items.speak: I was put on the spot. I panicked, and 'we' just came out.

items.en: Don't make me chase you for this. Just send the email.
items.jp: こんなことで追いかけさせないで。メールを送って。
items.speak: Don't make me chase you for this. Just send the email.

items.en: I've taken on two extra clients, but my pay hasn't changed.
items.jp: 顧客を2社追加で担当したのに、給与は変わっていません。
items.speak: I've taken on two extra clients, but my pay hasn't changed.

items.en: I did some research, and the going rate is about twelve percent higher.
items.jp: 調べたところ、相場は12%ほど高いです。
items.speak: I did some research, and the going rate is about twelve percent higher.

items.en: Gimme a week to talk to HR, and I'll come back with a plan.
items.jp: 1週間、人事と話させて。計画を持って戻るから。
items.speak: Gimme a week to talk to HR, and I'll come back with a plan.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:時間をもらう時

items.en: Can we put a date on the calendar so it doesn't slip?
items.jp: 流れないように、予定に日付を入れてもいい？
items.speak: Can we put a date on the calendar so it doesn't slip?

items.en: Dude, Chris just handed in his notice. Last day's the end of the month.
items.jp: なあ、クリスが退職届を出した。最終日は月末だって。
items.speak: Dude, Chris just handed in his notice. Last day's the end of the month.

items.en: Man, he basically held this team together.
items.jp: うわ、彼はこのチームをまとめてたようなものなのに。
items.speak: Man, he basically held this team together.

items.en: Guess who's gonna get his clients? Yep, you.
items.jp: 誰が彼の顧客を引き継ぐと思う？そう、君だよ。
items.speak: Guess who's gonna get his clients? Yep, you.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:予想を言う時

items.en: If I just say yes, I'll be saying yes to everything forever.
items.jp: ただ引き受けたら、ずっと何でも引き受けることになる。
items.speak: If I just say yes, I'll be saying yes to everything forever.

items.en: I'm already drowning, and now this? Come on.
items.jp: もう溺れそうなのに、さらにこれ？勘弁してよ。
items.speak: I'm already drowning, and now this? Come on.

items.en: Sam, I've worked here six years. 'Nothing' never looks like that.
items.jp: サム、ここで6年働いてるの。『何でもない』はそんな顔しない。
items.speak: Sam, I've worked here six years. 'Nothing' never looks like that.

items.en: I sent the wrong file to the client. It had the old pricing.
items.jp: お客さんに間違ったファイルを送った。古い価格が入ってた。
items.speak: I sent the wrong file to the client. It had the old pricing.

items.en: Don't hide it. Hiding it looks way worse than the mistake.
items.jp: 隠さないで。隠す方が、ミスよりずっと悪く見える。
items.speak: Don't hide it. Hiding it looks way worse than the mistake.

items.en: Call them now. Short, calm, honest. That's all.
items.jp: 今すぐ電話して。短く、落ち着いて、正直に。それだけ。
items.speak: Call them now. Short, calm, honest. That's all.

items.en: You're not gonna get fired over a wrong attachment.
items.jp: 添付ファイルを間違えたくらいでクビにはならないよ。
items.speak: You're not gonna get fired over a wrong attachment.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:安心させる時

items.en: I'd say yes if it were just once, but this is the third time.
items.jp: 一度きりなら引き受けるけど、これで3回目なんだ。
items.speak: I'd say yes if it were just once, but this is the third time.

items.en: I can't tonight. I've got plans I can't move.
items.jp: 今夜は無理です。動かせない予定があって。
items.speak: I can't tonight. I've got plans I can't move.
items.note: 元の形: I have got／聞こえ方: ガット／使う場面:予定を言う時

items.en: Here's what I can do. I'll come in an hour early tomorrow.
items.jp: こうならできます。明日1時間早く来ます。
items.speak: Here's what I can do. I'll come in an hour early tomorrow.

items.en: Can we set up some kind of heads-up system for these requests?
items.jp: こういう依頼に、前もって知らせる仕組みを作れない？
items.speak: Can we set up some kind of heads-up system for these requests?

items.en: Hey, Liz, you good? You've been quiet all day.
items.jp: ねえリズ、大丈夫？今日ずっと静かだね。
items.speak: Hey, Liz, you good? You've been quiet all day.
items.note: 元の形: are you good／聞こえ方: ユー グッド／使う場面:様子を気づかう時

items.en: Boss, can I grab five minutes before the meeting?
items.jp: ボス、会議の前に5分いただけますか？
items.speak: Boss, can I grab five minutes before the meeting?

items.en: Babe, don't wait up. I'll be late again.
items.jp: ねえ、待たないで。また遅くなるから。
items.speak: Babe, don't wait up. I'll be late again.

items.en: Buddy, it's not worth fighting over. Let it go.
items.jp: おい、争う価値はないよ。水に流そう。
items.speak: Buddy, it's not worth fighting over. Let it go.

items.en: Sir, I'd like to flag a concern before we move forward.
items.jp: 部長、進める前に一つ懸念を伝えたいです。
items.speak: Sir, I'd like to flag a concern before we move forward.

items.en: Lemme be honest. I don't think this plan is realistic.
items.jp: 正直に言わせて。この計画は現実的じゃないと思う。
items.speak: Lemme be honest. I don't think this plan is realistic.
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:本音を言う前に

items.en: I gotta say, that's not what I expected from you.
items.jp: 言わせてもらうけど、君からそんなことは予想してなかった。
items.speak: I gotta say, that's not what I expected from you.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:言いにくいことを言う時

items.en: We hafta fix this before the client finds out.
items.jp: お客さんに知られる前に直さなきゃ。
items.speak: We hafta fix this before the client finds out.
items.note: 元の形: have to／聞こえ方: ハフタ／使う場面:やるべきことを言う時

items.en: Dunno. Nobody told me the deadline moved.
items.jp: さあ。締め切りが動いたなんて誰も言わなかったよ。
items.speak: Dunno. Nobody told me the deadline moved.
items.note: 元の形: I don't know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:知らないと言う時

items.en: Beats me why they'd cut the budget now.
items.jp: なんで今になって予算を削るのか分からない。
items.speak: Beats me why they'd cut the budget now.
items.note: 元の形: it beats me／聞こえ方: ビーツミー／使う場面:理由が分からない時

items.en: Ya think the boss noticed? I really hope not.
items.jp: 上司は気づいたと思う？そうでないことを祈るよ。
items.speak: Ya think the boss noticed? I really hope not.
items.note: 元の形: do you think／聞こえ方: ヤ シンク／使う場面:意見を聞く時

items.en: Didja see the email? They moved the whole launch.
items.jp: メール見た？ローンチ全体が動いたよ。
items.speak: Didja see the email? They moved the whole launch.
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:出来事を伝える時

items.en: Whatcha gonna say when she asks about the numbers?
items.jp: 数字について聞かれたら、何て言うつもり？
items.speak: Whatcha gonna say when she asks about the numbers?
items.note: 元の形: what are you going to／聞こえ方: ワッチャ ガナ／使う場面:行動を聞く時

items.en: Y'know, I'm not mad. I'm just tired of doing this alone.
items.jp: ほら、怒ってるんじゃないんだ。一人でやるのに疲れただけ。
items.speak: Y'know, I'm not mad. I'm just tired of doing this alone.
items.note: 元の形: you know／聞こえ方: ヤノウ／使う場面:本音を言う時

items.en: Long story short, they chose the other vendor.
items.jp: 要するに、向こうは別の業者を選んだんだ。
items.speak: Long story short, they chose the other vendor.

items.en: Look, I'm not trying to blame anyone. I just wanna fix it.
items.jp: いいかい、誰かを責めたいんじゃない。直したいだけだ。
items.speak: Look, I'm not trying to blame anyone. I just wanna fix it.

items.en: I mean, it's not a disaster, but it's not great either.
items.jp: つまり、大惨事じゃないけど、良くもないってこと。
items.speak: I mean, it's not a disaster, but it's not great either.

items.en: Wait, what? They want it by tomorrow?
items.jp: 待って、何？明日までに？
items.speak: Wait, what? They want it by tomorrow?

items.en: Say again? I think I missed the part about the budget.
items.jp: もう一度言って？予算の部分を聞き逃したみたい。
items.speak: Say again? I think I missed the part about the budget.

items.en: Just talk normally. You don't have to sound like a memo.
items.jp: 普通に話して。社内メモみたいに話さなくていいよ。
items.speak: Just talk normally. You don't have to sound like a memo.

items.en: Chill. It's one email, not the end of the world.
items.jp: 落ち着いて。メール1通で、世界の終わりじゃないよ。
items.speak: Chill. It's one email, not the end of the world.

items.en: Relax, it's me. You can tell me what you really think.
items.jp: 気楽にして、私だよ。本音を言っていいよ。
items.speak: Relax, it's me. You can tell me what you really think.

items.en: No can do. I've already said yes to three other things.
items.jp: それは無理だね。すでに他の3件に了承してるから。
items.speak: No can do. I've already said yes to three other things.

items.en: Sounds good. Let's circle back on Thursday.
items.jp: いいね。木曜にまた話そう。
items.speak: Sounds good. Let's circle back on Thursday.

items.en: Running behind. Start without me.
items.jp: 遅れてる。先に始めてて。
items.speak: Running behind. Start without me.

items.en: Need a hand with the slides?
items.jp: スライドを手伝おうか？
items.speak: Need a hand with the slides?

items.en: Any luck with the client? Did they reply?
items.jp: お客さんの件はどう？返信あった？
items.speak: Any luck with the client? Did they reply?

items.en: C'mon, give me a chance to explain.
items.jp: ほら、説明させてよ。
items.speak: C'mon, give me a chance to explain.
items.note: 元の形: come on／聞こえ方: カモン／使う場面:食い下がる時
